Only calls made or received on this SIM are uploaded. Recordings of calls on any other SIM stay on the phone.

Where the dialer saves call recordings. Usually:
• Google Phone: Recordings › Call recordings (or Download/Call recordings)
• Xiaomi / Redmi / Poco: MIUI › sound_recorder › call_rec
• Samsung: Recordings › Call
• OnePlus / Realme / Oppo: Music › Recordings › Call Recordings
